svg.title: Timely HTTP success by concurrent heavy-request limit at 4,000 requests/s

cc:Work.dc:title: Timely HTTP success by concurrent heavy-request limit at 4,000 requests/s
cc:Work.dc:description: Two panels compare fiber pool with compute offload and virtual threads for light and heavy requests. Markers show medians and whiskers observed minima and maxima across three independent JVM pairs, not confidence intervals. Source: summary.json in the same results directory.
